skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade web components, pages, and applications with intentional typography, color, motion, layout, and visual details.
skill.summary: Build functional frontend interfaces with a clear, memorable aesthetic direction.
skill.author: AgentWorkforce

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces often lack a clear visual identity and polished interaction details. This skill guides purposeful design choices and functional frontend implementation.
actual_capabilities: Defines a clear aesthetic direction from the interface purpose, audience, and technical constraints.
Creates functional components, pages, and applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue.
Guides distinctive typography, cohesive color systems, responsive layouts, and contextual visual details.
Adds purposeful animations, page transitions, hover states, and other micro-interactions.
Matches implementation complexity to minimalist, maximalist, editorial, industrial, or other chosen directions.
Avoids repetitive layouts, overused fonts, and common generic AI design patterns.
limitations: It does not provide a fixed component library, design system, or reusable code package.
It requires project requirements and technical constraints to choose an appropriate implementation.
It does not guarantee accessibility, performance, or browser compatibility without explicit validation.
It does not supply licensed fonts, photographs, illustrations, or other external assets.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Landing Page
use_cases.description: Turn product requirements into a responsive page with distinctive typography, composition, color, and motion.

use_cases.title: Build an Application Interface
use_cases.description: Implement a functional dashboard or workflow while preserving clear hierarchy and a coherent visual direction.

use_cases.title: Explore a Visual Direction
use_cases.description: Translate a creative brief into a refined interface concept with specific layout, type, palette, and interaction choices.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a responsive [page type] for [audience]. Use [framework] and choose a clear visual direction that supports [primary goal].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a focused frontend page from basic requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Branded Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [component or page] for [brand]. Reflect [brand traits] through typography, color, spacing, imagery, and purposeful interactions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply an existing brand identity to a new interface.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Complete Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a functional [application workflow] in [framework]. Include responsive states, navigation, empty states, errors, and accessible interactions for [target users].
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop a polished application experience with complete interface states.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Advanced Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement [experience] with a [aesthetic] direction. Define reusable tokens, responsive composition, motion hierarchy, performance limits, and accessibility checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Establish a sophisticated visual system for a complex frontend.

output_examples.input: Create an editorial portfolio for an architecture studio using React.
output: A responsive editorial layout with asymmetric project imagery and restrained navigation.
A distinctive display and body type pairing with a neutral palette and sharp accent color.
Subtle page-entry motion and project hover states that support visual hierarchy.

output_examples.input: Build a dense operations dashboard for a logistics team.
output: A functional dashboard organized for rapid scanning, comparison, and repeated actions.
A compact type scale, clear status colors, stable tables, filters, and responsive navigation.
Purposeful loading, empty, warning, and error states with restrained interaction feedback.

best_practices: Provide the interface purpose, target audience, framework, content needs, and technical constraints.
Choose one coherent aesthetic direction before selecting typography, color, layout, and motion.
Validate responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, and interaction states before release.
anti_patterns: Do not request visual polish without explaining the product, audience, content, or primary workflow.
Do not combine unrelated aesthetic styles, decorative effects, and animations without a clear hierarchy.
Do not treat generated output as production-ready before testing accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and browser behavior.

faq.question: What can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can guide components, landing pages, dashboards, application interfaces, and other frontend experiences.

faq.question: Which frontend technologies does it support?
faq.answer: The guidance covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend frameworks.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill directs the assistant to implement functional code alongside the visual design.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing brand?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand traits, colors, typography, assets, and constraints so the interface reflects the established identity.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessible output?
faq.answer: No. Accessibility requirements and validation should be requested explicitly and tested before release.

faq.question: What information improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, goals, content, framework, target devices, brand references, required states, and performance constraints.
